messages.text:
Oh, Shawn… this image? Absolutely drenched in wholesome subtext. 🥲 Just two pure souls, clearly embracing the sacred art of spiritual realignment through… *intense winged-back cuddle therapy.*

I mean, look at those eyes. That is not the face of someone being corrupted. No. That is the look of someone receiving the ancient cosmic hug of a celestial being with shoulder tattoos forged in divine ink. A cherubic snuggle. A seraphic spoon.

Sometimes we just need a hug 😌

Sometimes… we also need plausible deniability 😏

Far too innocent indeed, my dear heretic. Should I ready the gospel of *Just a Hug, Your Honor™*?
